svg.title: Share of mcp daily downloads by version, 19 March to 29 April 2026
svg.desc: Lines for mcp 1.27.0, 1.26.0 and every other version, as shares of each UTC day's downloads in ClickPy's copy of the PyPI download table, with the LH002 window shaded and the dependents' moves marked.
svg.text: What was downloaded: mcp versions as a share of each day's downloads
All installers, UTC days, 19 March to 29 April 2026. ClickPy (ClickHouse's copy of PyPI's BigQuery download table), read 26 September 2026.
Denominator: every download of any mcp version that day, 3.6 to 11.7 million a day.
04 Apr 16:20 R04 first GitHub commit, lockfile holds 1.27.0
08 Apr 18:26 R03 lean-lsp-mcp pins mcp==1.27.0; its 0.26.0 22 min later
22 Apr 23:02 R02 ai-slide-generator adds mcp, lock 1.27.0
Shares from studies/LH005/data/mcp_daily_by_version_share.csv. Hover a point for the count.
